Superb cuisine
Jan 2020 • Couples
Hue House is located in a quiet courtyard off a busy street in District 1. We decided to sit inside and were the only patrons in this section of the restaurant. Surroundings were sleek and modern and the restaurant was extremely clean 

We started with the pomelo salad which was fresh and also had spring rolls stuffed with minced clans. 

For entrees we enjoyed brown rice noodles with pork. I ordered the spicy cassava noodles with baby clams and mushrooms. This dish was served with noodles and greens In a bowl. The clams and mushrooms were served in a separate bowl with a savory sauce. You then poured the sauce etc on the noodles and greens. 

For dessert we ordered a trio of sweet soups. The pomelo soup was so delicious that we ordered a separate portion of it. 

Soft Drinks were refreshing and thirst quenching. All in all this was a delicious and healthy meal. 

Service was friendly and attentive. Prices were very reasonable. 

Hue house in my opinion has to be one of the better restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City.

Delightful evening meal, contemporary Vietnamese food in great setting, highly recommended.
Nov 2019 • Couples
We found this delightful restaurant by chance. It's located in a quiet courtyard. The food was excellent and the staff explained the dishes and helped us to decide on our menu choices. We opted for spring rolls filled with shrimp paste and served with basil sauce - really great choice. For mains we selected two dishes from the signature range...green rice and chicken (delicious) and purple rice with pork, really great contemporary food. Also, the chef uses all natural colours eg beetroot, magenta plant, basil and pea, nothing artificial which is an added bonus. For dessert, we chose the triple selection together with chocolate ice cream and passion fruit ice cream. A wonderful end to a lovely meal. Great value for money...we would recommend it. The wine was also very good...cabernet sauvignon and sauvignon blanc....both excellent, we had 3 glasses each! Five stars all round.

Wonderful & Authentic
May 2019 • Couples
I went there for lunch with my wife and we were amazed at the authenticity and tastiness of the food served by Hue Contemporary Cuisine.

Located inside the compound of the old opium refinery at 74 Hai Ba Trung, District 1, Hue Contemporary Cuisine is the smallest sized restaurants within the compound.

There was a set lunch menu on offer for only VND90K+, which included a main and a dessert. However, we decided to go for ala carte as this was a new place for us and we wanted to try out their range of dishes. No regrets with our decision!

We started off with the banh beo, which was served in 3 different colors with 2 of each color: purple, white and pink. Don't ask me what differs between them - I can only say all 3 flavors were delicious.

Then we had a bowl of noodle next. If I recall correctly, it was the bún gạo lứt heo nướng với chả giò chạo tôm, which basically translates into brown rice noodle with grilled pork and shrimp spring rolls. At VND125K a bowl, it might seem expensive compared to a street food vendor, but for a proper dine in restaurant, it was very reasonable and again, it was delicious!

To round off the light lunch, we ordered a sweet potato dessert.

Definitely worth coming back again to try out all their other dishes!
